questions.q: From which figure did the name Quraysh begin?
questions.explain: Fihr seized power from Khuza'ah and the name Quraysh began with him.

options: An agreement and a guarantee of safe trade
questions.explain: Hashim made the ilaf agreements with tribes and great powers, making two trade journeys possible.

questions.q: Where did the Quraysh trade journey go in winter?
questions.explain: Winter to Yemen and summer to Sham, mentioned in Surah Quraysh.

questions.q: Why was Amr bin Abdul Manaf called Hashim?
options: Because he crumbled bread into broth for the pilgrims
Because he was born in Yathrib
questions.explain: Hashim derives from a word meaning to crumble bread.

questions.q: Who brought Shaybah back from Yathrib to Makkah?
questions.explain: Al-Muttalib, Hashim's brother, brought Shaybah, and from there the name Abdul Muttalib began.

questions.q: How did Abdul Muttalib rediscover Zamzam?
options: After dreaming over four days, then digging
questions.explain: After four days of dreaming, he dug and found the water of Zamzam.

questions.q: How many camels were set as the diyah after the ransom of Abdullah?
questions.explain: Diyah is the compensation for killing someone, set at a hundred camels.

questions.q: Makkah lay on the trade routes and was used to make it a commercial hub.
questions.explain: True. Hashim made use of Makkah's strategic position.

questions.q: A noble lineage decides a person's fate in the Hereafter.
questions.explain: False. A noble lineage is a high status but does not decide one's fate in the Hereafter.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: Abdullah is ransomed with a hundred camels

questions.explain: Fihr, Hashim's ilaf, Shaybah brought to Makkah, Zamzam found, then Abdullah ransomed.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: The gathering place of Makkah's leaders, like a parliament
The name from the descendants of Fihr

questions.explain: Quraysh is the name from Fihr, ilaf a trade-security agreement, Dar an-Nadwah a parliament-like hall, and azlam arrows of decision.

questions.q: When your provision increases, what example does Hashim give?
options: Share the wealth, as Hashim did with the pilgrims
questions.explain: When Makkah grew rich, Hashim shared with the pilgrims, and that is the origin of the name Hashim.
